sentences.en: I go to school to get an education.
sentences.zh: 我去学校接受教育。

sentences.en: The book is a great help for my study.
sentences.zh: 这本书对我的学习有很大帮助。

sentences.en: Knowledge comes from learning.
sentences.zh: 知识来自学习。

sentences.en: Use your reason to find the answer.
sentences.zh: 用你的推理来找到答案。

sentences.en: Science gives us knowledge about the world.
sentences.zh: 科学给我们关于世界的知识。

sentences.en: Art is a form of expression.
sentences.zh: 艺术是一种表达形式。

sentences.en: I learn to count numbers in math class.
sentences.zh: 我在数学课上学数数。

sentences.en: We have a test at the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 我们这周末有一个测试。

sentences.en: The class is learning about history.
sentences.zh: 这个班级在学习历史。

sentences.en: Every action has a reaction.
sentences.zh: 每个作用力都有反作用力。

sentences.en: Do you have knowledge of this subject?
sentences.zh: 你有这门学科的知识吗？

sentences.en: The teacher gives us a test on Friday.
sentences.zh: 老师周五给我们考试。

sentences.en: I study for one hour every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天学习一个小时。

sentences.en: The event of the science fair was a success.
sentences.zh: 科学展的活动很成功。

sentences.en: One example of a machine is a car engine.
sentences.zh: 机器的一个例子是汽车引擎。

sentences.en: The lesson changed the way I think.
sentences.zh: 这堂课改变了我思考的方式。

sentences.en: Natural science is about the natural world.
sentences.zh: 自然科学是关于自然世界的。

sentences.en: It is necessary to study to get knowledge.
sentences.zh: 学习是获取知识的必要条件。

sentences.en: A complete education takes many years.
sentences.zh: 完整的教育需要很多年。

sentences.en: The discovery of new things is exciting.
sentences.zh: 发现新事物是令人兴奋的。

sentences.en: We had a discussion about the book.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了这本书。

sentences.en: Development in science is happening every day.
sentences.zh: 科学的发展每天都在发生。

sentences.en: The detailed explanation was very clear.
sentences.zh: 详细的解释非常清楚。

sentences.en: Every error in the test was a chance to learn.
sentences.zh: 测试中的每一个错误都是一次学习的机会。

sentences.en: The map of the world was on the wall.
sentences.zh: 世界地图挂在墙上。
